info.title: uFeed API
info.description: Self-hosted, multi-user, multilingual RSS/Atom reader. Internal API under /api, public API under /api/v1.

post.description:
Use the app without registering: an account with no personal data (App
Store 5.1.1(v)). It reads and manages a few feeds; AI, the server voice
and the rest need a real account (see `upgrade`). Limited per IP and per
day, and deleted after a long absence.

A guest registers: same feeds, folders and saved articles, now with an
email and password (and the regular plan).

Email a one-time link to choose a new password. Always answers the same,
so it doesn't reveal which addresses have an account.

Set a new password from an emailed link (once); signs out every other
session and signs this one in.
Change your password. Other sessions are signed out; this one gets new tokens.

Delete your own account and all its data (feeds, folders, saved and
read state, API keys). Asks for the password; the last administrator
can't delete themselves (the instance would be left without one).

schema.title: Response List Keys Api Keys Get

post.description: Hide articles whose title or summary contains this word or phrase.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api Sources Get

get.description: Your feeds with their health status, problems first.

schema.title: Response Sources Health Api Sources Health Get

post.description:
Called when the app opens: fetch this user's feeds that are due.

This is what keeps content fresh for returning users (the worker only polls
feeds of recently active users). Doesn't spend the plan's manual-refresh
cooldown; has its own short per-user cooldown and a time budget.

Fetch the user's feeds now (or one source) and report what was found.

Rate-limited per plan (admin-editable; defaults in app.core.roles).

get.description: The badge numbers: unread in your own feeds, as the lists show them.

Other copies of this story (same duplicate group): in your feeds, and in
feeds you don't follow, to read them or to follow that feed.

schema.title: Response Article Twins Api Articles  Article Id  Twins Get
Response Similar Api Articles  Article Id  Similar Get

get.description:
The article's AI summary in `lang` (default: yours).

Stored once made, so every later reader in that language gets it at once.
With generate=true a missing summary is queued for the on-device LLM (the
plan sets the place in the queue and the daily allowance); the reply says
where it is (status queued/running, position, eta_s) and the app asks
again until it's ready. Without generate=true nothing is queued.

post.description:
Fetch (once) and return the full article from its web page, for feeds
that only publish an excerpt. Shared by every reader.

get.description:
The article machine-translated into `lang` (default: yours). Generated
on demand (generate=true), stored and shared; ~3-4 s for a long article.

post.description:
The article read aloud by the server's neural voice (plan feature).

Generated once per article and language (~25x real time on the NAS CPU)
and shared by every reader; returns a short-lived signed URL to play it.

get.description:
Serve an article's MP3: the finished file (with Range support, which iOS
needs to seek), or -- while it's still being generated -- a live stream
that follows the file as it grows.

schema.title: Response Get Trending Api Trending Get
Response Get For You Api Foryou Get

The starter suggestions curated by editors (sections=None: the app's
built-in list applies).

put.description: Replace the limits of the given plans (others keep their values).

get.description:
One page of users, filtered and sorted by the database. Guests are left
out unless asked for (`guests=all|only`): there can be thousands.
Totals for the dashboard (counted in the database, no lists).

post.description:
Delete the guest profiles idle for `days` or more (what the nightly
clean-up does, with the number of days you choose).

delete.description: Delete an account and all its data. Admins must be demoted first.

post.description: Set a random temporary password (shown once) and sign the user out.

get.description:
Resource monitor: load/memory/storage/users samples and daily usage of
the heavy features (voice, translation, AI summaries).

post.description: Apply the retention policy now instead of waiting for the nightly run.

Undo a deactivation for inactivity (stops the pending deletion).
Ban the account's email (temporary or permanent); blocks re-registering.

get.description: Every feed on the instance, problems first, with subscriber counts.

AISummaryOut.title: AISummaryOut
AISummaryOut.description: LLM summary of an article in one language (null until generated).

AdminSummary.title: AdminSummary
AdminSummary.description: The whole user base at a glance, counted by the server (no lists loaded).

AdminUserPage.title: AdminUserPage
AdminUserPage.description: One page of the user list (filtered and sorted by the server).

ApiKeyCreated.title: ApiKeyCreated
ApiKeyCreated.description: Returned only once, at creation time, with the plaintext key.

ApiKeyOut.title: ApiKeyOut
ApiKeyOut.description: API key metadata (never includes the secret).

Catalog.title: Catalog
Catalog.description:
The starter suggestions new accounts see. `sections` is None while the
instance uses the built-in list shipped with the app.

DigestOut.title: DigestOut
DigestOut.description: The most relevant unread articles of the last hours from your feeds.

FullTextOut.title: FullTextOut
FullTextOut.description: The article's full text (from its web page), when the feed had only an excerpt.

Maintenance.title: Maintenance
Maintenance.description: Storage/retention/backup status for the admin panel.

SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig
SiteConfig.description: Public, unauthenticated instance info (sign-up state, plan limits).

SyncResult.title: SyncResult
SyncResult.description:
Opportunistic refresh on app open; skipped=True when nothing was due or
the per-user sync cooldown applies.

TemporaryPassword.title: TemporaryPassword
TemporaryPassword.description: Shown once to the admin; the user must change it at next sign-in.

TranslationOut.title: TranslationOut
TranslationOut.description: An article machine-translated into `lang` (null until generated).

TwinOut.title: TwinOut
TwinOut.description:
Another copy of the same story. `article_id` is set only when it is in a
feed the user follows; otherwise just enough to read it on its site or to
follow that feed.

UnreadCountsOut.title: UnreadCountsOut
UnreadCountsOut.description: What the badges show: the user's own unread, one per duplicate story.

UpgradeRequest.title: UpgradeRequest
UpgradeRequest.description: Turn a guest into a registered account (same data, real credentials).
